name: Huerta de Rey (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a red diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huerta de Rey (quartered with castles, a figure and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Huerta de Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
